feature.name: Original interactive Component Lab
feature.objective: Preview and export locally authored interactive components without running third-party catalogue code.
feature.audience: Designers and developers using the unified workbench
acceptance_criteria: Six original demo component types with accessible interactive states
Isolated responsive previews at desktop tablet and mobile widths
Compatible validated shared token themes including browser-saved theme
Offline standalone HTML export plus validated editable JSON import/export
Zero paid services, no third-party script execution
Automated unit, browser, type and repository CI validation

source_of_truth.source_version_or_revision: new original component lab feature branch
source_of_truth.authority_rule: Repository-owned theme tokens and examples are canonical; external indexed sources remain discovery metadata only.

design_system.contrast_review: Existing palette validator; final product contrast requires manual review.

component_registry.purpose: Toggle button, tabs, accordion, validation form, toast and demo metric
component_registry.license_review: Original code only; no external license introduced
component_registry.keyboard_and_screen_reader_review: Native semantics, roles, ARIA and keyboard tabs

interactions.success_condition: Sandboxed preview and read-only source reflect user edits
interactions.failure_condition: Invalid edits preserve previous validated configuration
interactions.cancellation_or_undo: Reset sample or import saved JSON

interactions.success_condition: Standalone offline file or validated JSON generated
interactions.failure_condition: Invalid or oversized import preserves current component

tool_runs.input_artifact: main branch and existing design-token schema
tool_runs.decisions: No new packages or remote preview execution.
Automated checks plus manual accessibility review required.

quality_gates.security_review: iframe sandbox with separate origin; restrictive CSP; no external assets or network requests; validated inputs

decisions.decision: First-party standalone examples rather than running indexed catalogue code
decisions.reason: Avoids executing unreviewed third-party code and preserves zero-cost static deployment.
Preview matches standalone exported HTML without trusting preview content as the parent origin.

handoff.next_stage: validate tests, fix defects, review and merge PR
